name: The Pink Passion
notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (23 September 1998), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/pink-passion-roleplay-read-please-1998-09-23.html: The Pink Passion, lounging on a pink bed with his mistress Rebekka, flirts with HHWO's wrestlers and says he will give Vincent Lockheart a pink makeover.
caption: A cigar-smoking pretty boy in an all-pink house who wants gold on pink, September 1998.

name: Ben Cardone
notes: Known from one free-agent introduction served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/free-agent-ben-cardone-1998-11-25.html: the leader of the New Dynasty, an aristocratic technical wrestler in a pinstriped suit who offers a cameraman a cigarette and says three days in the HHWO have bored him, 'the emotionless masterpiece known as Ben Cardone'.
caption: A pinstriped aristocrat who leads the New Dynasty into the HHWO in November 1998.
